verdict.statement: The actual 101-question bank requests complete in-scope procedural coverage of original 2023 English Uprising standard 2–4-player play, including the required scoring two-player Rival, optional standard CHOAM and applicable official FAQ clarifications. No genuine new rule/outcome/timing/priority/exception gap remains. No additions proposed. Source-locator precision issues are recorded separately and do not create procedural gaps.

scope: 2023 English Uprising v23-10-12, standard 2–4-player multiplayer including required two-player Rival, optional standard CHOAM; no solo, Rival variants, six-player teams or cross-game expansions. Relevant official FAQ January 13 2025 clarifications included.

independence_statement.method: Built the challenge from all actual questions and key answers against complete authorized source texts, original printed Shaddam image and Rival resource image. Compared each possible addition against the entire question bank; key-only background did not count as requested coverage. Only communicated task status to the assigning parent. PDF text equivalence checked page by page; visual-icon and arithmetic evidence are distinguished.

source_locator_findings.finding: Many early key locators give only "extraction" without naming either differently lineated authorized main text, and some supplied ranges miss relevant lines or point at unrelated content under one interpretation. PDF page/rule labels are generally correct.

examples.issue: Those extracted-main lines are credits; wild icon is extracted-main1118–1120 / named run-main1225–1227.
Its bare extraction306–310,327–329,1162–1164 do not fully locate Signet and card-precedence rules in either main text. Exact run-main328–332,349–350,1290–1291 supplied here.
Ordinary discard lives at extracted-main1129–1131 / run-main1236–1238, not the supplied bare1104–1106.

source_locator_findings.resolution: Use the independent exact named-file locators for every question below. No question addition is needed.

source_locator_findings.finding: The supplied key delegates exact references to source-reference-appendix.json, which was not an authorized audit input and was not opened. Underlying statements are independently confirmed directly using authorized sources and image regions, with complete replacement locators below.

qualification_notes.note: Generic CHOAM setup is 2 public offers plus18 bank. When Shaddam is chosen, original printed set-aside rule produces2 offers plus16 public bank and2 reserved contracts; Q102 directly and correctly tests that exception. Read Q16 as generic module setup, not an unconditional count for every Leader.
Other humans' fallback despite unacquired Shaddam reserves is supported jointly by public-icon fallback and original printed exclusive access, rather than a single verbatim FAQ sentence.
Conversion rates verified from four icon rows of the unannotated p5 image; text extraction alone is insufficient.
Both reserved contracts and exclusive acquisition are printed original-Leader facts.18 public/16 bank are arithmetic consequences, explicitly identified below.

independent_procedural_coverage_map.covered_rules: Conflict construction; Leader/Objective selection; score, Agents, troops, Influence/Alliance, Wall, bank/Hooks, decks/Row/Reserves and remaining components.
Five phases; round reveal/draw; first-player/clockwise/skip order; Reveal sequence and early commitment; Rival completion exception; Combat priority/closure/update/reset; Recall/end timing.

Hand/Leader origins, unoccupied/matching access, one Agent, no-icon prohibition, pre-entry requirements/costs, Plot-before-entry permission, optional arrows and direct self-trash, normal effects order and Shaddam onset exception.
Source/post legality, specified icon, no-supply recall, card recalls, Agent-icon access, Infiltrate/Gather timing, distinct-purpose/per-placement limits, optionality.

Gain/pay origins; limited troop supply; Intrigue storage/timing/exhaustion; draw/discard/trash/Reserve destinations; purchase sources/costs/refill; acquire triggers; in-play/Bond/Alliance/Influence conditions; named in-scope FAQ timing exceptions.

Threshold rewards/reversibility/repeatability, Alliance tie/loss/transfer, indivisible Influence, generic card precedence/Signet trigger and all in-scope printed rulebook Leader clarifications plus original Shaddam set-aside.
Troop supply/garrison/conflict and deployment count; optional deployment; retreat; worm bank/Conflict and Hooks/Wall constraints; Maker accumulation/collection; control and defense.

Strength calculation/zero eligibility; priority and any-number Intrigues; reward allocation by player count and every tie branch; doubling/cost/match exceptions; cleanup; 10-VP/deck triggers; Endgame Intrigues/wilds, score beyond12 and all tiebreakers.
Complete guide p1–2 reviewed: every space access/Combat status plus costs, requirements, bundles, choices, persistent timing and control payments. No six-player spaces counted.

All setup, ongoing Agent turns, Hagal reshuffles/destinations/conditional failures and every icon family, priority/scheme Spies, resource upgrades/conversions, Maker branches, Combat bonus/response, normal reward/scoring/control and contract exception.

20 standard contracts vs10 Ix-only; randomized setup/extra cards; original Shaddam reserved-pool exception; acquisition/refill/public exhaustion fallback; four completion types, ownership-at-placement, mandatory multiple completion/effect order and token destination; Rival conversion.
